noveltyStatus.reason: The readiness capture promoted the graph-instance and Sentinel tenant-check response contracts; the catalog route was correctly absent while the observed tenant was not provisioned.
noveltyStatus.nextRequirement: Reopen only when Sentinel Graph reaches a different readiness state or an exact unmodeled graph catalog, connector, query, status, or response contract is available.
noveltyStatus.reopenCondition: The Sentinel Graph readiness state emits an action-attributed graph-instance, tenant-check, catalog, or connector-status contract not represented in the checked-in Defender baseline.

targets.safeAction: Open Sentinel Graph readiness and passively capture graph-instance inventory traffic without selecting setup controls.
targets.rationale: Graph instance inventory is a passive readiness read and can provide a concrete empty or populated response shape without enabling graph features.

targets.safeAction: Open Sentinel Graph readiness and passively capture the normal tenant eligibility check; do not invoke provisioning or connector setup.
targets.rationale: The tenant check is a body-bearing readiness probe observed during normal page load; observe-only capture can enrich it without crossing into provisioning.

targets.safeAction: Open Sentinel Graph readiness and passively capture catalog metadata if the normal readiness state requests it.
targets.rationale: Catalog metadata is a passive read that can clarify graph table availability while remaining outside setup, connector, trial, and purchase controls.
